metaTitle: Jaguar Engine Inspection & Assessment | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Professional Jaguar engine inspection and rebuild assessment in Essex. Visual, diagnostic, and strip-down inspection to provide a clear scope and fixed-price quote.
lede: We carry out a structured inspection of your Jaguar engine to establish the exact condition, identify what's needed, and give you a fixed-price quote for rebuild or repair.

sections.heading: What Our Jaguar Engine Assessment Involves

blocks.html: We assess your engine to determine the scope of work required - whether it's a full rebuild, targeted repair, or replacement. The process covers:

items: **Visual inspection** - external condition, fluid checks, belt/chain condition, and evidence of leaks or wear.
**Diagnostic scan** - we connect to the vehicle's ECU to read live data and performance parameters.
**Component-level checks** - using borescope cameras, compression testing, and leak-down testing where appropriate.
**Partial strip-down (if required)** - removing the cylinder head, timing cover, or sump to inspect bearings, timing components, and cylinder bores.
**Detailed quotation** - a written report with a fixed-price breakdown, scope of recommended work, and clear options.

blocks.html: The goal is to give you an accurate picture of your engine's condition without unnecessary disassembly, so you can make an informed decision.

paras: We provide a fixed-price quote after completing the inspection, based on the specific scope required for your engine.

steps.title: Vehicle arrival & history review
steps.body: We record your Jaguar's details, mileage, and service history. This gives us a baseline before any physical checks begin.

steps.title: Visual inspection & diagnostic scan
steps.body: We inspect the engine bay, fluid levels, and external components. We then connect diagnostic equipment to gather live sensor data.

steps.title: Component-level evaluation
steps.body: Using borescopes, compression gauges, and leak-down testers, we assess cylinder bores, valves, piston rings, and sealing surfaces without full disassembly.

steps.title: Partial strip-down & measurement
steps.body: If the scope requires it, we remove the cylinder head, timing cover, or sump to measure bearing clearances, timing component wear, and bore ovality.

steps.title: Assessment report & fixed-price quote
steps.body: We compile our findings into a written report, outline the recommended scope (rebuild, repair, or replacement), and provide a fixed-price quotation for you to review.

sections.heading: Why Choose Jaguar Garage for Inspection & Assessment

items: **Jaguar-specialist knowledge** - we know the common wear points on every generation of AJ, Ingenium, and Ford-sourced engines.
**Proper equipment** - we use factory-level diagnostic scanners, borescopes, and precision measuring tools.
**Clear, transparent reporting** - you get a written breakdown of what we found and what we recommend, with no obligation to proceed.
**Fixed-price quotes** - once the assessment is complete, we quote a firm price for the recommended work.

steps.title: Book your inspection
steps.body: Contact us to arrange a date to bring your Jaguar to our workshop.

steps.title: We carry out the assessment
steps.body: Our team performs the visual, diagnostic, and component-level checks - including strip-down if needed.

steps.title: Review the report & quote
steps.body: You receive a detailed written report and a fixed-price quotation for the recommended scope of work.

steps.title: Decide on the next steps
steps.body: You choose whether to proceed with the rebuild, repair, or alternative option - with no obligation to commit.

items.q: How long does a Jaguar engine inspection take?
items.a: Standard visual and diagnostic checks take 2-3 hours. If a partial strip-down is required, we usually keep the vehicle for 1-2 days to complete the full assessment.

items.q: Do I have to proceed with the rebuild after the inspection?
items.a: No. The assessment gives you the information you need to decide. You are under no obligation to commission any further work.

items.q: What if you find unexpected damage during the strip-down?
items.a: We will stop at the point we identify additional issues, contact you with an updated scope and revised quote, and wait for your authorisation before continuing.

items.q: Do you inspect Ingenium diesel engines?
items.a: Yes. We have specific assessment procedures for AJ200D and other Ingenium engines, including timing chain wear and injector seal checks.

items.q: Do you provide a written report?
items.a: Yes. Every assessment includes a detailed written report with our findings, measurements, and a clear recommendation for the next steps.

items.q: Can you inspect an engine that's already been removed from the car?
items.a: Yes, we can assess loose engines on our workshop stands. Contact us to arrange delivery and we'll quote accordingly.
